scripts.initialize:
set -euo pipefail
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends xvfb xauth libgl1-mesa-dri libglx-mesa0 libegl-mesa0 libxcursor1 libxinerama1 libxrandr2 libxi6 libxkbcommon0 libfontconfig1 python3-pil unzip curl
if [ -x game/tools/install_godot.sh ]; then
  game/tools/install_godot.sh --templates mobile
  scripts/import.sh >/dev/null
else
  echo "game/tools/install_godot.sh is not on this branch; skipping Godot"
fi
scripts.refresh:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -x game/tools/install_godot.sh ]; then
  game/tools/install_godot.sh --templates mobile
fi
